.lab-code-viewer pre { position: relative; max-height: 40vh; white-space: pre; }
.lab-code-hit { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--lab-accent) 24%, transparent); outline: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--lab-accent) 60%, transparent); }
.lab-code-summary { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 14px; margin: 4px 0 6px; color: var(--lab-muted); }
.lab-code-sections { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin: 6px 0; }
.lab-doctor { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; max-width: 1100px; }
.lab-doc-top { position: sticky; top: -10px; z-index: 2; background: var(--lab-bg); padding: 4px 0; margin: 0; }
.lab-doc-primary { background: var(--lab-accent) !important; color: var(--lab-accent-ink) !important; border-color: var(--lab-accent) !important; font-weight: 600; }
.lab-doc-verdict { border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--lab-line2); background: var(--lab-bg2); }
.lab-doc-stack { display: flex; height: 22px; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--lab-bg3); }
.lab-doc-stack span { display: block; height: 100%; min-width: 2px; cursor: pointer; border-right: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); }
.lab-doc-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-top: 6px; }
.lab-doc-key i { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; }
.lab-doc-layer { position: relative; display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; text-align: left; padding: 5px 8px !important; overflow: hidden; }
.lab-doc-layer-name, .lab-doc-layer-tris { position: relative; z-index: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.lab-doc-layer-bar { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; background: rgb(47 194 171 / 0.22); }
.lab-doc-card { border: 1px solid var(--lab-line2); border-left-width: 4px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--lab-bg2); padding: 8px 12px; margin: 6px 0; }
.lab-doc-card header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.lab-doc-sev, .lab-doc-area { font-size: 0.82em; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--lab-bg3); color: var(--lab-muted); }
.lab-doc-ab-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px 160px 1fr; gap: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.lab-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--lab-bg2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lab-line); cursor: move; user-select: none; flex: none; }
.lab-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 1.08em; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--lab-accent); }
.lab-meters { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto; padding: 1px; }
.lab-tools { display: flex; gap: 2px; flex: none; cursor: default; }

.lab-meter { --meter: var(--lab-accent); display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; grid-template-rows: auto 4px 16px; column-gap: 6px; row-gap: 2px; align-items: center;
  min-width: 78px; padding: 3px 7px 2px; background: var(--lab-bg3); border: 1px solid var(--lab-line); border-radius: 7px; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
.lab-meter-value { justify-self: end; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--meter); }
.lab-meter-bar { grid-column: 1 / 3; height: 4px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; }
.lab-meter-fill { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--meter); transition: width 0.25s; }

.lab-panel button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: inherit; border: 1px solid var(--lab-line2); border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 3px 8px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
.lab-panel button.on, .lab-panel button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--lab-accent); color: var(--lab-accent-ink); border-color: var(--lab-accent); }
.lab-panel button:focus-visible, .lab-panel input:focus-visible, .lab-panel select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lab-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
.lab-panel input, .lab-panel select, .lab-panel textarea { background: var(--lab-bg3); color: inherit; border: 1px solid var(--lab-line2); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 6px; font: inherit; }
.lab-main { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: row; }

.lab-tabs { flex: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; width: 176px; padding: 6px; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; border-right: 1px solid var(--lab-line); background: var(--lab-bg2); }
.lab-tab-group { margin: 8px 6px 2px; font-size: 0.78em; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6f838c; white-space: nowrap; }
.lab-tab { justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; border-color: transparent !important; background: transparent !important; color: var(--lab-muted) !important; padding: 5px 8px !important; }
.lab-tab.on { color: var(--lab-accent) !important; background: rgb(47 194 171 / 0.14) !important; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--lab-accent); }
.lab-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; min-width: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 10px 12px 14px; }
.lab-body h3 { margin: 14px 0 6px; font-size: 0.92em; color: #a9bcc4; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.lab-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 6px 0; }
.lab-card { background: var(--lab-bg2); border: 1px solid var(--lab-line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; margin: 6px 0; }
.lab-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }

.lab-panel pre, .lab-code { background: #0a1013; border: 1px solid var(--lab-line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; overflow: auto; max-height: 50vh;
  font: 11px/1.45 ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; white-space: pre; }
.lab-status { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--lab-line); background: var(--lab-bg2); font-size: 0.92em; }
.lab-status-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; gap: 10px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.lab-rec { color: var(--lab-bad); font-weight: 700; animation: lab-blink 1s steps(2) infinite; }
.lab-table-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 4px 0; }
.lab-table-scroll { max-height: min(62vh, 720px); overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--lab-line); border-radius: 8px; resize: vertical; }
.lab-table table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.lab-table th { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; background: var(--lab-bg3); text-align: left; padding: 5px 7px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 600; color: #b9c9cf; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lab-line2); }
.lab-table td { padding: 3px 7px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04); max-width: 380px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.lab-table td.bar { background: linear-gradient(to left, rgb(47 194 171 / 0.22) var(--bar), transparent var(--bar)); }

.lab-investigate { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: min(560px, 62%); min-width: 320px; z-index: 5; overflow: auto; padding: 10px 12px 16px;
  background: var(--lab-bg); border-left: 1px solid var(--lab-line2); box-shadow: -14px 0 30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); }
.lab-inv-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; position: sticky; top: -10px; background: var(--lab-bg); padding: 2px 0 6px; z-index: 1; }
.lab-inv-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; color: var(--lab-accent); }
.lab-inv-title strong { color: var(--lab-text); font-size: 1.1em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lab-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--lab-bg3); border: 1px solid var(--lab-line); color: var(--lab-muted); font-size: 0.9em; }
.lab-inv-fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr; gap: 2px 12px; margin: 6px 0; padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--lab-bg2); border-radius: 6px; }
.lab-inv-fields dd { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.lab-inv-table th { text-align: left; color: var(--lab-muted); font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 6px; }
.lab-inv-table td { padding: 2px 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--lab-line); max-width: 260px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.lab-inv-table tr:hover td { background: rgb(47 194 171 / 0.12); cursor: pointer; }
.lab-table td.lab-look button { padding: 2px 3px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--lab-muted); opacity: 0.55; }
.lab-table tbody tr:hover td.lab-look button { opacity: 1; color: var(--lab-accent); }
.lab-investigate h3 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 12px 0 6px; font-size: 0.92em; color: #a9bcc4; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
.labres-kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; margin: 6px 0; }
.labres-kpi { background: var(--lab-bg2); border: 1px solid var(--lab-line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; }
.labres-kpi-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; }
.labres-kpi-head strong { font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--lab-text); }
.labres-verdict { margin: 6px 0; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--lab-bg2); border: 1px solid var(--lab-line); border-left: 3px solid var(--lab-muted); }
.labres-pct td:first-child, .labres-pct th:first-child { text-align: left; color: var(--lab-muted); }

.panel { background: var(--panel); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--panel-3) transparent; }
.panel h3 { margin: 18px 0 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); }
.row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr 38px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 28px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.row output { text-align: right; color: var(--ink-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11px; }
.seg { display: flex; background: var(--panel-2); border-radius: 7px; padding: 2px; gap: 2px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.seg button { flex: 1; border: 0; padding: 6px; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2); }
.seg button.on { background: var(--panel-3); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #3a4048; }
.swatches { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; align-items: center; }
.swatches button { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12); cursor: pointer; padding: 0; }
.swatches input[type=color] { width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 0; padding: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; }

.tile { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--panel-2); padding: 9px 6px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); min-height: 40px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.2; }
.tile img { width: 56px; height: 56px; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 6px; }
.tile.on { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); background: var(--accent-soft); }

.tool { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--panel-2); height: 52px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 10.5px; }
.tool.on { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.chips button { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel-2); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 9px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.chips button.on { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); }
.check { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; color: var(--ink-2); margin: 6px 0; cursor: pointer; }

.big { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 10px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink); margin-top: 6px; }
details.fine summary { cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); padding: 6px 0; list-style: none; }
.pics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px; align-content: start; }
.panel > .picker { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 150px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 8px; }

.picker-search { display: none; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 8px; }
.picker-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 0; }
.panel .bar { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px; }

.toggle { width: 32px; height: 30px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; flex: none; }
.toggle.on { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); }
.picker-bar { height: 30px; margin-top: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.picker-arrow { width: 28px; height: 24px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; }

.pic { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2b3038, #1f2228); padding: 0; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.pic img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.pic span { padding: 4px 5px 5px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; text-align: center; }
.pic.on { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); }
.stage { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%, var(--stage-top), var(--stage-bottom) 75%); }
.top { position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; top: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; pointer-events: none; }

.busy { position: absolute; top: 52px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: rgba(22, 24, 28, .85); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); display: none; }
.stats { position: absolute; left: 14px; bottom: 16px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-3); line-height: 1.5; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.side { background: var(--panel); border-left: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 14px; gap: 8px; }
.side h2 { margin: 0 0 2px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); }
.gallery { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; align-content: start; margin-top: 4px; }

.card { position: relative; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; padding: 3px; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.card img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; background: #2a2f37; display: block; margin-bottom: 3px; }

.card .x { position: absolute; top: 5px; right: 5px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 4px; border: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; opacity: 0; }
.subtabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px; margin: -2px -2px 12px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.subtabs button { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-3); }

.panel .loading { height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent), transparent); background-size: 50% 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; animation: lab-loading 1s linear infinite; margin: 12px 0; }
.signal-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin-top: 6px; }
.signal-chip i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff5b50; box-shadow: 0 0 6px currentColor; color: #ff5b50; }
.bw-inspector-title { color: var(--bw-muted); font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.bw-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 76px 14px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--bw-muted); font-size: 11px; }
.bw-field-text { grid-column: 2 / -1; color: var(--bw-text); font-size: 11px; text-align: right; }
@media (max-width: 780px) { .bw-inspector { width: min(230px, calc(60vw - 12px)); top: 136px; max-height: calc(100dvh - 330px); } }
.v2-icon.on, .v2-pill.on { color: var(--v-accent); border-color: var(--v-accent); background: var(--v-accent-soft); }
.v2-swatch { width: 24px; height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--c); }
